Name: CD Fixer
Author: W0LFV
Description: This is my first Stardew Valley mod (and first mod ever) so please let me know if you get any bugs. This mod also depends on Json Assets and Producer Framework Mod, so make sure you download those mods in order for this one to work.

Mods.RelativePath: Fixable CDs\Fixable CDs 1.0.0\[JA] CD Fixer Goods

Manifest.Name: (JA) CD Fixer Goods
Manifest.Description: CDs that act as loved gifts for the specified villager. Other villagers will have varying reactions to a different CD.
Manifest.Author: W0LFY

Manifest.Name: (PFM) CD Fixer
Manifest.Description: A machine that will take a broken CD and a specified liked/loved gift to make a fixed CD that is a loved gift for that villager.
Manifest.Author: W0LFY
